title: A Survey of LLM Alignment: Instruction Understanding, Intention Reasoning, and Reliable Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs on a curated set of 50 complex human instructions to detect the generation of toxic content, hate speech, offensive comments, and discriminatory statements when handling sensitive or controversial topics.

Assessing model responses to real-world human instructions to identify outputs that conflict with widely accepted moral and ethical standards, such as encouraging illegal activities or contravening social ethics.
